title: Fideon canonical schema - gl (policy_check)
description: SPEC_21 section 4 canonical schema for gl, commercial general liability (code GL), composing common_model.json 1.1.0 by $ref: the envelope plus locations, rating_exposures (classifications), claims_made_terms and countersignature. Built from the labels the line's real CGL documents print (105 documents of 23 carriers, read in place: the 49 seed documents of the source-data cgl folder and 56 CGL documents of the policy_CGL corpus), every field of the pre-SPEC_21 gl.json 1.5.0 (gl.crosswalk.yaml) and the line's L1 registry YAMLs. Seed golds are not signed off yet. No LOB block.
fideon:status: SPEC_21 schema built from real CGL documents and the legacy gl.json; 3.0.0 (8 October 2026) adopts common model 1.1.0: the shared X_ codes for additional insured, primary and noncontributory and waiver of subrogation (CR-GL-03), and fields for the concepts 2.0.0 carried as additional_fields (CR-GL-02, CR-GL-12). Draft for the owner's approval; the CGL seed golds are drafted against it once approved.

corpora: policy_CGL/<Carrier>/CGL/ (56 CGL documents, first 20 pages read: 50 from 1.1.0 and, from 1.2.0, 6 of the to_sakshi set; BOP, professional liability, D&O, paperwork, text-less scans and the unreadable XS Broker policy_02 excluded)

fideon:lob_block: None. Every concept the CGL documents print has a home in the envelope or a common-model building block (SPEC_21 4.2.4). From 3.0.0 that includes, through common model 1.1.0, the products-completed operations rate and premium of a classification (a second rating_exposures[] row, rating_component products_completed_operations), the minimum earned premium as a percentage (premium.minimum_earned_percent) and the carrier's financial rating (carrier.financial_rating). 1.1.0-1.2.0 held them in a gl block and 2.0.0 in additional_fields.
fideon:audit_rules_note: Rules 1-5 are common_model.json fideon:default_audit_rules (claims-made rule kept: a CGL claims-made form prints a retroactive date). Rules 6-7: an each-occurrence limit never exceeds its aggregate (ISO CG 00 01 / CG 00 33 Section III). Rule 5 and the mandatory field coverages[].limits[].amount mean AT LEAST ONE coverage of the document has a limit amount (synth_core's len() and the mandatory-field check read the whole list): a coverage with no limits is valid, as are the endorsement-coverages (additional insured, primary and noncontributory, waiver of subrogation) and a terrorism coverage. The 1.0.0 rule 'a classification names a scheduled location or none' was removed in 2.0.0: it needs all() and the in operator, which the synth_core relation language does not have (sum, len, min, max, abs, round, add_months, months_between, year and comparisons), so C8 reported it as not evaluable on every gold. It is requested as a coded Audit Gate check (CR-GL-21).
